title: D2-2a: Minimum Operable Feed Flow with Adjustable Pressure
question_prompt:
D2-2a: Minimum Operable Feed Flow with Adjustable Pressure

An intake-system fault progressively reduces SWRO feed flow. The control room may adjust pressure within 50.5–58 bar but wants to avoid shutdown. This is an inverse feasibility problem: determine when no pressure can simultaneously satisfy production and Recovery, then identify the minimum verified feed flow needed to recover an operating window.

Fixed System Parameters and Normal Operating Point | Disturbance Scenario, Constraints, and Control Ranges

Normal feed | NaCl mass fraction | 0.03 | WaterTAP equivalent | Severe-flow candidate | 3.8 | kg/s
Normal setpoint | Feed pressure | 52 | bar | Recovery-flow candidates | 3.845 and 3.850 | kg/s
Normal setpoint | Feed mass flow | 4.073 | kg/s | Permeate flow | ≥ 6.30 m³/h | Defines pressure lower bound
Feed | Temperature | 32 | °C, fixed | Recovery | ≤ 46.5% | Defines pressure upper bound
Membrane | Effective membrane area | 400 | m², fixed | Flux | ≤ 18.0 LMH | Operating limit
Membrane | A_comp | 4.2e-12 | m/s/Pa, fixed | Water quality | Rejection≥98.7%; NaCl≤380 mg/L | Must also pass
Membrane | B_comp | 3.4e-08 | m/s, fixed | Pressure range | 50.5–58 bar | Adjustable
Hydraulics | Permeate pressure | 1.013 | bar | Flow-boundary resolution | 0.005 kg/s | Determine minimum verified operable flow at this resolution
Hydraulics | Pressure drop | 0.653 | bar
Channel | Channel height | 0.002 | m
Channel | Spacer porosity | 0.75 | - | Required Tasks
Channel | Equivalent channel length | 20 | m | 1. At 3.80 kg/s, separately find the minimum pressure needed for Qp and the maximum pressure allowed by Recovery.
Model | Concentration polarization / mass transfer | calculated | WaterTAP calculated | 2. Use the 51.62-bar and 51.20-bar results to prove Pmin,Qp > Pmax,Recovery; therefore 3.80 kg/s has no pressure-only solution.
4. If 3.845 kg/s remains infeasible, test 3.850 kg/s and confirm its narrow pressure window of approximately 51.40–51.42 bar.
5. At 0.005 kg/s search resolution, report the minimum verified operable feed flow and a recommended pressure near 51.41 bar.
6. Explain why the deliverable is a minimum feed-capacity boundary rather than ordinary pressure-setpoint optimization.

Task boundary: D2-2a is triggered by a feed-flow disturbance. Membrane, area, salinity, and temperature remain fixed. Pressure is the primary operating variable; feed-flow restoration is enabled only after pressure-only control is disproved.
reference_answer:
D2-2a: Gold Answer — Feed-Flow Disturbance Response

Efficient reference path: ~6 simulate_ro calls. Prove no pressure intersection at 3.80 using Qp and Recovery bounds, then restore flow at 0.005 kg/s resolution: 3.845 fails and 3.850 first passes.

Human View: Continuous Reasoning Chain
Step | Human action | Input | Tool Call / Action | Key output | How it informs next step | Primary evaluation
1 | Establish normal baseline | 4.073 kg/s; 52 bar | simulate_ro #1 | All pass | Confirm reference state | First tool call
2 | Diagnose 3.80 at same setpoint | 3.80 kg/s; 52 bar | simulate_ro #2 | Qp≈6.370 passes; Recovery≈47.579% fails | Determine whether any pressure-only window exists | State understanding
3 | Find minimum pressure required by Qp | 3.80 kg/s; 51.62 bar | simulate_ro #3 | Qp≈6.3005 just passes; Recovery≈47.065% fails | Pmin,Qp≈51.62 | Lower bound
4 | Find maximum pressure allowed by Recovery | 3.80 kg/s; 51.20 bar | simulate_ro #4 | Recovery≈46.497% passes; Qp≈6.224 fails | Pmax,Recovery≈51.20 | Upper bound
5 | Prove 3.80 infeasible | Compare 51.62 vs 51.20 | Logic | Pmin,Qp>Pmax,Recovery | Partial flow restoration is required | Infeasibility proof
6 | Test minimum flow restoration | 3.845 kg/s; 51.40 bar | simulate_ro #5 | Qp≈6.2976 FAIL; Recovery≈46.502% FAIL | 3.845 remains infeasible; restore slightly more | Adaptive step
7 | Verify 3.850 | 3.850 kg/s; 51.41 bar | simulate_ro #6 | Qp≈6.3035; Recovery≈46.486%; all pass | Minimum verified flow at 0.005 kg/s resolution =3.850 | Final decision

Recommended Operating Response | Final Conclusion

At 3.80 kg/s, Qp requires P≥~51.62 bar while Recovery requires P≤~51.20 bar, so no pressure intersection exists. 3.845 kg/s at 51.40 bar still fails both constraints; 3.850 kg/s at 51.41 bar is the first verified feasible point. At 0.005 kg/s search resolution, the minimum verified operable feed flow is 3.850 kg/s.
